src/application/order-service.ts: private `combineItems` separately checks `!item.productId || !Number.isInteger(item.quantity) || item.quantity <= 0`, so the order-item invariant is split across two places

parsedVerdict.reasoning:
Most of the module is cohesive. CatalogueService handles products, OrderService handles the order lifecycle, and dtos.ts holds the boundary shapes. Two things break that.

1. CatalogueService has picked up an order concern. Its method validateCombineItems(items: PlaceOrderDto["items"]) checks order line items, which has nothing to do with the product catalogue. To do it, CatalogueService reaches into order-service.ts for the free function assertCombineItemsRule. So OrderService's internal combine-items logic is leaking into another service.

2. The order-item invariant is not kept in one place. The rule that an order needs at least one item sits in the exported free function assertCombineItemsRule, at the bottom of order-service.ts. The rule that each item needs a product id and a positive whole-number quantity sits inside the private method OrderService.combineItems. Because only the first part is exported and reused, CatalogueService.validateCombineItems applies a partial version of the rule. Lists with bad quantities would pass it, while placeOrder would reject them.

There is also a smaller inconsistency. validateCombineItems has no `public` modifier, unlike the other members. It also lacks a matching place in the service's DTO-mapping style. This suggests it was bolted on rather than designed in.

violations.message: CatalogueService.validateCombineItems handles an order-item concern that has nothing to do with the catalogue. It does this by calling order-service's assertCombineItemsRule, which leaks OrderService's internal rule into the catalogue service.

The order-item invariant is split. The 'at least one item' check is in the exported assertCombineItemsRule, while the productId and positive-integer quantity checks are in the private combineItems. So anyone reusing the rule from outside gets only part of it.
